source.note: Shirt-sponsor table lists Elche - Flexicar (Automotive); the article adds that Elche announced the deal after its first match.
source.quote: Elche and Espanyol started the season without a principal partner, but both announced deals after their first match.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Sleeve-sponsor table lists Elche - MGS Seguros (Financial services - insurance).
source.quote: Three clubs – Elche and promoted sides Málaga and Racing Santander – have even agreed with the same company MGS Seguros.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: While they continued with Barcelona, Atlético de Madrid, and Elche.

summary: Flexicar on the front, MGS Seguros on the sleeve, Nike as kit maker. No back-of-shirt or shorts sponsor for Elche is named in the overview or anywhere else we looked: the article names Elche only among the clubs without a named back sponsor.
